candidate_source: final per-image Top-300 detections from the formal release
candidate_order: descending final score; exact score ties preserve original prediction-record order

matching.successful_action: same-category, non-crowd, previously unmatched GT with IoU >= tau
matching.multiple_eligible_gt: maximum IoU, then smaller annotation id for an exact IoU tie
matching.duplicate_action: no eligible unmatched GT, but a same-category already matched GT has IoU >= tau
other_invalid_precedence: category_error: a different-category non-crowd GT has IoU >= tau
localization_insufficient: some same-category non-crowd GT has 0 < IoU < tau
matching.crowd_policy: crowd GT is excluded from matching and from the target denominator
matching.empty_gt_images: retained; every executed prediction is an other-invalid background action

aggregation: compute full-Test counts and metrics separately for each method and seed; report three-seed mean, sample standard deviation, and paired Full-minus-B0 seed differences

input_audit.bbox_format: COCO xywh in image pixel coordinates
input_audit.degenerate_bbox_policy: count and report finite boxes with non-positive width or height; retain their score-queue positions, assign IoU zero, and count an executed degenerate candidate as an other-invalid background action
input_audit.out_of_bounds_bbox_policy: count and report boxes extending beyond image bounds; preserve the exported coordinates unchanged for matching; do not clip or discard

test_role: post-hoc reporting only; no model, checkpoint, threshold, parameter, or protocol selection
claim_boundary: This is an offline detection-driven sorting-proposal proxy. It does not measure physical grasp success, realized recovery rate, robot-cycle time, or a closed-loop robotic sorting system.
